prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Glowcap Hollow: a blue-dusk village beneath enormous glowing mushrooms and beside dark blue pools. A gentle wonder-filled melody with celesta-like plucks and flute. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
